Validate Feed Intake Imputation

Source: R/validate.R
validate_adfi.Rd

Hide recorded daily feed intake on purpose, impute it again and compare with the recorded values. Only pigs whose stage is well covered by records are used, and errors are measured on the recorded days only.

validate_adfi(
  adfi,
  methods = c("linear", "loess"),
  scenarios = c("random30", "blocks3", "late20", "early15"),
  reps = 5,
  min_coverage = 0.8,
  max_pigs = NULL,
  seed = 1,
  verbose = 1,
  cores = 1
)

Arguments

adfi

Result of calc_adfi().

methods

Imputation methods to compare (values of impute_method).

scenarios

Patterns of hidden days:

  • "random<p>": p% of the recorded days at random, e.g. "random30";

  • "blocks<n>": n blocks of 3-10 consecutive days, e.g. "blocks3";

  • "late<d>": the first d days of the stage (late entry);

  • "early<d>": the last d days of the stage (early exit).

reps

Number of repetitions per scenario. Default 5.

min_coverage

Pigs with at least this share of recorded stage days are used. Default 0.8.

max_pigs

Use a random sample of at most this many of these pigs. Default NULL: all.

seed

Random seed.

verbose

0 (silent), 1 (summary and progress, default).

cores

Number of CPU cores. Default 1.

Value

A list of class ppt_validation with

  • summary: one row per scenario and method: mean_abs_error_pct and p95_abs_error_pct (error of the ADFI of each pig, % of the recorded ADFI), bias_pct, spearman (rank correlation of ADFI with the recorded ADFI), daily_rmse (g/d, hidden days) and n_pigs;

  • per_pig: the error of every pig, scenario, repetition and method;

  • settings.
